purpose: Latihan PKSK Tahap 2/Tahun 6 untuk kemasukan Tingkatan 1 sekolah khusus/SBP

part_a.name: Kecerdasan Insaniah
part_a.scoring_note: Objektif bergred; bukan model jawapan betul/salah biasa

part_b.name: Kecerdasan Intelek
part_b.scoring_note: Objektif aneka pilihan; item latihan menggunakan satu jawapan terbaik kecuali konfigurasi item menyatakan sebaliknya

generation_rules.part_a_style: situational, forced-choice/graded-response style; avoid trivial factual recall
generation_rules.part_b_style: mixed IQ, academic, knowledge and problem-solving items
generation_rules.part_b_english: include dedicated English items within the 70-item allocation
generation_rules.math: more challenging reasoning than routine primary-school drill; use relevant visual/stimulus where useful
generation_rules.science: conceptual and quantitative reasoning where appropriate
generation_rules.part_c: three genuinely distinct writing prompts; each must support rubric-based simulation

source_notes: KPM public PKSK materials describe three parts: A Kecerdasan Insaniah, B Kecerdasan Intelek, C Artikulasi Penulisan.
KPM 2026/2027 announcement confirms PKSK for Tingkatan 1 and Tingkatan 4; this project targets Tahun 6 preparation for Tingkatan 1 entry.
Public PKSK format references consistently describe A=30, B=70, C=3 prompts choose 1, with 20/70/10 weighting and 100-word minimum for Tingkatan 1.
